summary: Defined durable OS run state reconciliation for AgentOS boot recovery, including truth precedence across RunStore, AuditJournal, rollback state and future active ecosystem artifact state.
acceptance_evidence: runtime-state-reconciliation.md defines boot-time reconciliation ordering from packaged runtime validation through RunStore, AuditJournal, rollback store, active artifact state and operator projection.
Truth precedence makes AuditJournal authoritative for effect truth and prevents RunStore, model output or active artifact state from overriding sealed audit evidence.
Half-committed EffectPrepared records without CommitSealed or RollbackObserved are unresolved and map to Recovering, RollbackPending, Suspended or FailedClosed depending on effect class.
The contract reserves active artifact state reconciliation for later ecosystem activation tasks while keeping staged artifacts inert.
The no-model-replay rule forbids model output from reconstructing recovery truth.

1 passed; support bundle manifest links run ids and audit ranges while redacting secret values.

blocked_shortcuts: No model replay as recovery authority.
No half-committed effect can be silently completed.
No restart may auto-grant pending approval.
No staged ecosystem artifact is treated as active.
No active artifact state may override audit truth.
promotion_impact: Starts Wave 2 durable runtime state by defining boot recovery truth and support evidence needed for PID 1 operation and later ecosystem activation.
